redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-created metadata and non-production fixtures only.
Public official regulations, pages, catalogs, specifications or repositories retained as references; access does not imply row or artifact redistribution rights.

An exact artifact whose declared GODL-India, Apache-2.0 or other licence permits recorded fields and derivatives, with provider, edition, coverage, schema, CRS, validity, attribution and digest pinned.
Registered, request-delivered, licensed or restricted material used and redistributed only as specifically permitted.
Personal, query, unclear-license, third-party API, search-only, viewer-only or non-redistributable evidence may detect discrepancies but cannot become public output.

sources.provider: Department of Posts, Government of India
sources.production_scope: Regulation 175 defines PIN as a six-digit postcode for a particular area mapped to the post office receiving mail for delivery under its jurisdiction. It supplies semantics, not a complete current assignment table, official boundary file or building relation.

sources.provider: Department of Posts via Open Government Data Platform India
sources.production_scope: The official monthly directory provides PIN and typed office assignment fields. Each exact resource edition, coverage, GODL declaration, API or download schema and digest must be pinned; multiple office rows and delivery status are preserved and rows are not geometry.

sources.provider: Department of Posts via Open Government Data Platform India
sources.production_scope: The official catalog states that a Department of Posts PIN Boundary GeoJSON exists. Production requires the exact resource URL and bytes, edition, source coverage, declared licence, CRS, topology, feature-key relation and digest. Catalog metadata alone is not geometry.

GODL-India permits broad lawful reuse for an exact covered dataset subject to its conditions and attribution. Individual dataset metadata controls; this legal framework is not PIN, boundary, address or building evidence.

sources.provider: Ministry of Panchayati Raj via Open Government Data Platform India
sources.production_scope: A pinned LGD edition may relate village and local-body records to PIN context. It is an administrative crosswalk, not Department of Posts assignment authority, PIN geometry, civic address or building evidence.

sources.provider: Department of Posts, Government of India
sources.production_scope: The official technical document and Apache-2.0 repository define a deterministic ten-character geocode for approximately four-metre cells over stated bounds in EPSG:4326 WGS84 epoch 2005. DIGIPIN complements an address and is not a PIN assignment, postal boundary, building, person or booking entitlement.

ABDB offers state, district, subdistrict and village administrative context. Each exact product, edition, access terms, coverage, CRS and digest must be pinned. Administrative boundaries do not become PIN boundaries or address-building links.

This public third-party service may support rate-limited validation after terms and provenance review. It is not India Post, Department of Posts official data, a canonical assignment archive, geometry authority or redistribution grant.

artifact_partitions.contents: Pinned six-digit PIN with circle, region, division, office type, delivery status, district, state and validity.
Exact Department of Posts GeoJSON artifact and joined assignment edition with source CRS, topology, licence and digest.
Optional versioned, uncertainty-bearing, non-canonical surfaces from permitted evidence.
Head, Sub and Branch Office records and permitted points, preserving Delivery and Non Delivery status; never converted into surrounding official polygons.
Versioned DIGIPIN specification or encoder output as a parallel location-grid layer, not PIN or building evidence.
LGD crosswalks and separately licensed Survey of India context, never silently treated as postal geometry.
Permitted civic-address evidence and exact rights-cleared building joins separate from PIN and DIGIPIN membership.
Source coverage tracked without geopolitical inference; recipients, correspondence, residence, ownership, private access and queries excluded.
